Isocyanates are compounds that contain the functional group -N=C=O. They are characterized by having a nitrogen atom connected to a carbon atom by a double bond, and the carbon atom is also connected to an oxygen atom by a double bond. The general formula is R-N=C=O, where R represents an organic group.
